summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.61/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.61 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 25, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 11¢ lower than a week ago, 69¢ lower than a month ago, and 66¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.45) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.83).
